What it pins: page 1's text layer prints the CNX Nifty, CNX Nifty Junior and CNX 100 tables'
columns apart — names under truncated statements ("The following companies"), then the
statements' tails ("are being excluded:"), then the symbols on their own — so no row can be
attributed to a statement. Before M14.1 the CNX Nifty and Junior sections vanished without a
word, and the NIFTY 50 history walked back across the 2014-03-28 change (JPASSOCIAT, RANBAXY out;
TECHM, MCDOWELL-N in) without applying it. They must be unparsed. Pages 2-3 (CNX 200, CNX 500)
lay out normally but state no effective date of their own, so those stay unparsed too.
